rules.statement: The formalities required to be observed when transferring and/or selling a land or other immovable property as laid down in Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance were not followed when executing the deed.
rules.supporting_quote: In terms of Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance a sale or transfer of land has to be in writing signed by two or more witnesses before a Notary, duly attested by the Notary and the witnesses. If this is not done, the document and its contents cannot be used in evidence [Samarakaan v. Gunasekera and Another (2011) 1 SrLL.R. 149].
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
